label: BL
reason: Two findings reported. 1) Insecure randomness (Lines 63-64) is a True Positive (TP) as Math.random() is unsuitable for session tokens. 2) XSS (Lines 103-108) is a False Positive (FP) because the printed cookie data ('rememberMe') is server-generated in the 'else' block, not sourced from the client request despite the taint trace suggesting otherwise. Due to conflicting TP/FP assessments, BL is assigned.

evidence.note: Uses Math.random() for rememberMeKey generation, which is a weak entropy source (TP).
Prints cookie name/value to response, but data originates from server-side generated Cookie object in else block, not client input (FP).
